El Día de las Elecciones es el martes 3 de noviembre, y la votación anticipada cierra el domingo 1 de noviembre. Quiero asegurarme de que todos los votantes elegibles del Distrito 26 de Florida cuenten con la información necesaria para hacer escuchar su voz.

Durante el período de votación anticipada, usted puede votar en cualquier centro de votación anticipada, de 7:00 a.m. a 7:00 p.m.. En el Día de las Elecciones, los centros de votación estarán abiertos de 7:00 a.m. a 7:00 p.m., y usted deberá votar en su centro de votación asignado.

Nuestro gobierno funciona mejor cuando los ciudadanos participan en el proceso democrático. Sin importar cómo decida emitir su voto, tómese unos minutos ahora para planificar y asegurarse de estar preparado.

Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, and early voting closes on Sunday, November 1. I want to make sure every eligible voter in Florida's 26th Congressional District has the information they need to make their voice heard.

During early voting, you can vote at any early voting location from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.. 
On Election Day, polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., and you should vote at your assigned polling place.

Our government works best when citizens participate in the democratic process. No matter how you choose to cast your ballot, take a few minutes now to make your plan and make sure you are prepared.

There is no justification for the slaughter of families, the taking of hostages, or the terror inflicted upon the people of Israel. October 7 stands as a painful reminder of the threat posed by antisemitism and by those who seek to spread terror and violence.

I stand firmly with the people of Israel and remain steadfast in my support for America’s closest friend and strongest ally. The United States must continue to confront terrorism and antisemitism wherever they arise and stand resolutely against those who seek to spread hatred and violence.

May we continue to remember the victims, stand with the survivors, and ensure that the atrocities of October 7 are never forgotten.

Estados Unidos no aceptará esta persecución política. El régimen debe saber que sus abusos no quedarán impunes y aquellos que reprimen, encarcelan e intimidan al pueblo cubano tendrán que rendir cuentas por sus acciones.

This investment will support the planning and design of improvements at NW 170th St. and NW 154th St., helping improve traffic flow, shorten commutes, and make these heavily traveled areas safer for South Florida drivers.
